column1: # ZAP Baseline exceptions for the Angular template CI harness.
# Every ignored rule must have an explicit architecture/deployment rationale.
10049\tIGNORE\t(Fingerprinted static JS/CSS assets are intentionally cacheable; index.html is served with Cache-Control: no-store.)
10055\tIGNORE\t(Angular autoCsp owns the script policy in a generated meta CSP; the complementary HTTP CSP intentionally omits default-src/script-src to avoid conflicting policies.)
10109\tIGNORE\t(Informational classification: the target is intentionally a modern JavaScript web application.)
90004\tIGNORE\t(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy is application-specific and is not required by the baseline unless the application adopts cross-origin isolation.)
